name: Barbell Bench Press
coachTips: Keep your shoulder blades pinched together
Do not flare your elbows 90 degrees
stepsList: Lie flat on the bench with eyes under the bar
Grip bar slightly wider than shoulder-width
Unrack and lower with control to lower chest
Press up explosively to starting position

name: Incline Dumbbell Press
coachTips: Squeeze chest at the top of movement
stepsList: Sit on bench with dumbbells on thighs
Kick weights to shoulder level and lie back
Press weights upward over upper chest
Lower slowly until mild chest stretch
mistakesList: Setting incline too high (>45 deg shifts to shoulders)

name: Pull-Ups
coachTips: Lead with your chest towards the bar
Full dead-hang stretch at the bottom
stepsList: Hang from bar with overhand grip wider than shoulders
Pull chest up by driving elbows down into ribs
Clear chin over bar
Lower slowly to full extension
mistakesList: Half reps without full range of motion

name: Lat Pulldown
coachTips: Drive elbows straight down to floor
stepsList: Adjust knee pad securely
Grip wide bar with overhand grip
Pull bar down to upper chest level
Control bar back up smoothly

name: Barbell Back Squat
stepsList: Position bar across upper traps
Step back, feet shoulder-width apart
Hinge hips and bend knees downward
Drive through midfoot back to stand

name: Romanian Deadlift
coachTips: Push hips backward like closing a car door
stepsList: Hold bar at hips with shoulder-width grip
Hinge at hips, sliding bar down thighs
Lower until hamstrings feel deep stretch
Drive hips forward to stand tall
mistakesList: Squatting down instead of hip hinging

name: Overhead Dumbbell Shoulder Press
coachTips: Keep core engaged to prevent spine hyperextension
Elbows slightly tucked in scapular plane
stepsList: Sit with back supported, dumbbells at ear height
Press weights upward until arms extend overhead
Lower with control back to ear level

name: Standing Barbell Bicep Curl
coachTips: Keep elbows pinned to your sides
stepsList: Stand tall with underhand grip on barbell
Curl bar upward toward chest keeping elbows stationary
Lower smoothly over 2 seconds
mistakesList: Moving elbows forward to cheat range

name: Dumbbell Lateral Raise
coachTips: Pour out a pitcher of water angle at the top
stepsList: Stand with weights at sides, slight forward torso tilt
Raise arms outward to sides until parallel with floor
Hold for a split second, then lower under control

name: Triceps Cable Pushdown
stepsList: Grip rope or straight bar at chest height
Push down until arms are fully extended
Pause and squeeze triceps
Return slowly to chest height
mistakesList: Letting elbows drift forward and back

name: Dumbbell Walking Lunges
stepsList: Hold dumbbells at sides
Step forward into a deep lunge until back knee nears floor
Push off front foot to step through into next lunge

name: Standard Core Plank
coachTips: Tuck tailbone slightly, squeeze glutes and quads
stepsList: Rest on forearms and toes with body in straight line
Brace core as if expecting a punch
Hold for specified duration breathing steadily
